verdicts.why: The Kree Empire/Earth-625 page lists Ronan as a (former, deceased) member and his page lists the Kree Empire with Yon-Rogg among his allies; he leads his forces against Xandar in episode 10 and dies there, so the membership runs through his whole record.

The wiki says Quill 'agreed to join the Avengers' and joined them against Ego, then went into space with the team, so the stage holds. Episode 11 is in season 2, and the 1988 Avengers (Hank Pym, Bill Foster, T'Chaka, Wendy Lawson) all use 'What If...? S2' as the title, so the stage should use that form.
The wiki's lead says this Grandmaster 'was the leader of Sakaar' (citizenship Sakaaran), and it shows no overthrow. That matches 'Sakaar' as used for T:grandmaster and T:by-grandmaster.

Marvel Database gives his occupation as Ruler of Polemachus. He introduces himself as 'Arkon, ruler of Polemachus' and leads its raids for slaves. A nation named plainly can be a new group, styled like Asgard and Sakaar.

The Marvel Database infobox gives his affiliation as House of Talos. Danica's House wakes him, and he takes up their cause and fights Blade from their base. He is the vampires' progenitor, not paid help. The factions sweep already recorded 'The House of Talos' for him.

The wiki says Domingo 'was the leader of the Colon Crime Family' (affiliation) and ran its business through Luke Cage S1 until he died attacking Diamondback. The name is plain, styled like 'The Stokes Crime Family'.

The wiki says he joined Abomaste at Blonsky's Summer Twilights retreat in 2025 and attends its meeting in episode 7 (affiliation Abomaste, category Abomaste Members). No departure is shown in his title.
The wiki says 'Alexander Gentry is a member of the Abomaste', that he joined at the retreat, and that he attends its episode 7 meeting. The Abomaste page lists him as an active member.

The wiki says he 'joined the Abomaste, run by Emil Blonsky' and attends its meeting in episode 7 (affiliation Abomaste, listed as an active member). The wiki's 'former' label rests on nothing shown in his title.
Topaz heads the Sakaaran Guards and is the Grandmaster's bodyguard (citizenship Sakaar), and she dies chasing the Revengers. That matches T:by-topaz, whose command of the guards is filed as 'Sakaar'.

The Monster Hunting Cabal page lists Liorn, Joshua Jovan, Barasso and Azarel as former, deceased members, and they compete in the cabal's hunt at Bloodstone Manor. Spelling: T:verussa-bloodstone's proposal uses 'Monster Hunting Cabal' without 'The'. The two must use one spelling.

The wiki says Colonel General Luchkov 'is a high-ranking officer of the Russian Armed Forces' (Soviet service only formerly) and appears in uniform in The Avengers. Armies count as groups, and the name is plain, alongside 'Soviet Armed Forces'.

The wiki calls him King of Latveria. Citing First Steps, it says he left Latveria's UN seat empty as its representative, which puts his rule during the film. A nation named plainly can be a new group.
In the film, Kraven tells him 'You run the Kirov Gang', and the wiki lists him as its leader (affiliation Kirov Gang). He is killed while leading it.

Both wiki pages give the affiliation as Norse Paganists, with Nystrom as leader and Larsen as a leading member of the cult that riots in Oslo and hunts the staff in 'The Well'. Cults count, and the name is plain.

The wiki says 'Habooska led the Booskans speeder gang' in the raid on Indigarr until Thor killed him. The dataset files marauder races as armies in the same way ('The Dark Elves', 'The Chitauri', 'Skrulls').

The owner already dropped 'Weapon X' for this record in the factions sweep: 'the Deadpool films never name the Workshop as Weapon X'. The wiki also says Ajax hired him to bring in recruits, so he counts as hired help. Whether he goes in 'The Workshop' depends on the owner's call on Ajax and Angel Dust.
Marvel Database says only that he 'sought work underground' and called 'his current employer, Silvermane'. That makes him a hired scientist, which is hired help, not a member of Silvermane's Mob.
